showcase.h2Accent: more time for the work that pays

panels.title: Walking out of the meeting
panels.text: One tap and you dictate in the car park. The text lands clean, titled and filed.

panels.title: The meeting, already summed up
panels.text: Chapters, key points, decisions and actions, each with the moment it was said.

panels.title: Before you call the client
panels.text: "What did we agree?" Your notes answer and cite their sources. One tap opens the note.

panels.title: Your agent takes over
panels.text: A photo of the whiteboard, and your own Hermes turns it into a plan while you head home.
